Hi there - Where can I find the status of my order? I have not received any information of these miners

Get Outlook for iOS<https://aka.ms/o0ukef>

Hi there,

Sorry you haven't heard anything about your miners. I'd like to check exactly where they are, but your message didn't come with an order number, so I can't pull up the order yet.

Please reply with your order number. It looks like Shop···· and it's on your order confirmation email. Please also send one detail I can match it against: the name the order ships to, the delivery postcode, or the email address you used at checkout.

Once I have those, I'll reply with where your order stands. If it has shipped, I'll send the tracking link. If it hasn't, I'll give you the date it ships.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi,

Thanks, I found your order Shop····. It's paid and covers two Magic M. 40Ts plus the Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA, shipping to (address hidden). Nothing has shipped yet.

I'm sorry you haven't heard from us. Your order was set to ship November 14, and that date has now passed. Nobody wrote to explain why, and we should have. The cause was a control board issue at the factory that stopped production during the first run. That issue is fixed and the final version is approved.

I don't have a confirmed new ship date for your two units, and I won't guess one. I've passed your order to the team, who pick it up today at 10am ET. They'll email you the current date.

When your miners ship, the tracking number comes to this email address automatically. You can also follow the shipment on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
